subject: erratics
art_note: At the actual original wooded moraine, both halves use the unchanged selected native ground and the same weathered rocks, till and small woodrush. Right adds wind-combed communities of low silverleaf: genuinely connected runner stems, opposite folded leaves and sparse spent ivory headtufts, on the true physical surface and outside existing rocks. Leave gaps along the stream of mineral fragments. No invented edible plant or game state.
